source.title: СВЕТ — 30 схем освещения
source.author: @mama_mozg
source.note: The source is a practical prompt/lighting library, not a scientific performance study.

schemes.light_logic: Large soft key from upper-left around 45°, weaker front-right fill, narrow rear rim for separation.
schemes.copy_space: Often reserve clean negative space opposite the hero; source example uses right-side copy space.
schemes.attention_use: Balanced product volume plus rim separation; good neutral baseline when hierarchy should come from layout rather than drama.
cautions: Can feel generic if composition and brand treatment are weak.

schemes.light_logic: Single elevated side soft key producing sculpted light and deep shadow; no fill.
schemes.copy_space: Use the quieter shadow side only when text contrast remains stable.
schemes.attention_use: Sculpted light concentrates attention on selected product planes.
cautions: Deep shadow can hide labels/details.

schemes.light_logic: Hard side key at roughly 90° splits the subject into lit and shadow halves.
schemes.copy_space: Keep copy away from the split edge and unstable gradients.
schemes.attention_use: Creates an immediate high-contrast silhouette and dramatic focal division.
cautions: Can sacrifice product readability; use only when brand supports drama.

schemes.light_logic: Large frontal elevated beauty source with lower reflector fill; soft symmetrical shadow.
schemes.copy_space: Works with centered compositions and clean top/bottom or side copy zones.
schemes.attention_use: Symmetry and frontal sheen emphasize product polish and brand cleanliness.
cautions: Too even for brands needing strong drama.

schemes.light_logic: Two narrow rear/side strip lights trace product edges against black.
schemes.copy_space: Dark field can provide excellent copy space if edge glows do not cross text.
schemes.attention_use: Edge separation makes silhouette the focal cue without brightening the whole product.
cautions: Over-rimming can look synthetic; labels may need controlled front detail.

schemes.light_logic: Large soft sources on both sides plus overhead diffusion create even near-shadowless illumination.
schemes.copy_space: Easy to create clean copy zones, but white text needs a tonal plate or dark color.
schemes.attention_use: Removes visual noise; hierarchy must come from scale, typography, color, and composition.
cautions: Can flatten form if product and background values are too similar.

schemes.light_logic: Small gridded soft key with controlled spill; most of the frame remains shadow.
schemes.copy_space: Use dark quiet regions for copy but verify local contrast and not-black clipping.
schemes.attention_use: A small controlled highlight creates strong focal priority.
cautions: Details and legal/label information can disappear.

schemes.light_logic: Single hard directional side light in a dark environment with strong falloff to black.
schemes.copy_space: Prefer quiet dark regions with stable tone; avoid textured light transitions behind type.
schemes.attention_use: Brilliant highlights against deep shadow can isolate the hero strongly.
cautions: Can feel theatrical or old-fashioned for modern utility brands.

schemes.light_logic: Bare hard key from high side angle creates a long sharp geometric shadow.
schemes.copy_space: Treat the shadow as a compositional vector; keep small copy off sharp shadow boundaries.
schemes.attention_use: Shadow can lead the eye and create a graphic second shape.
cautions: Shadow can become a competing AOI.

schemes.light_logic: Very large close softbox wraps smoothly around the product with gentle gradients.
schemes.copy_space: Excellent for minimal layouts with controlled tonal backgrounds.
schemes.attention_use: Emphasizes shape/material gently without creating aggressive hotspots.
cautions: Needs other hierarchy cues in small banners.

schemes.light_logic: Large diffused backlight illuminates liquid through the object; dark side cards define edges.
schemes.copy_space: Place copy outside bright refractive zones; protect label readability.
schemes.attention_use: Internal glow and dark edge definition make transparency/material the focal feature.
cautions: Highlights can wash out labels and fine copy.

schemes.light_logic: Back source is blocked centrally so light grazes only glass edges against black.
schemes.copy_space: Dark center/background can be copy-safe if edge highlights are kept away.
schemes.attention_use: Glowing contours focus attention on silhouette and glass geometry.
cautions: Product body can become too dark for recognition.

schemes.light_logic: Backlight through diffusion creates white field; black side cards define edges.
schemes.copy_space: Clean but requires dark text/CTA or a colored brand plate.
schemes.attention_use: Makes transparent object readable without dramatic clutter.
cautions: Can look generic if brand cues are absent.

schemes.light_logic: Strip source reflected through diffusion creates a smooth highlight gradient across glossy form.
schemes.copy_space: Keep copy away from the specular gradient; use quieter opposite side.
schemes.attention_use: Specular gradient reveals curvature and premium material quality.
cautions: Gradient can resemble artificial CGI if too perfect.

schemes.light_logic: Subject sits on translucent frosted surface illuminated from below with gentle top fill.
schemes.copy_space: Avoid placing primary copy directly in the brightest base glow.
schemes.attention_use: Under-glow anchors attention at the product base and creates technological separation.
cautions: Can feel gimmicky outside tech/premium contexts.

schemes.light_logic: Short-duration strobes freeze splash/droplets; backlight reveals translucent liquid.
schemes.copy_space: Reserve a clean side/top region; droplets are high-frequency clutter behind text.
schemes.attention_use: Frozen motion gives strong saliency and freshness cues around the hero.
cautions: Splash can overwhelm small banners; easy to look synthetic.

schemes.light_logic: Different colored rim lights from opposing sides plus moderate frontal fill.
schemes.copy_space: Protect copy from chromatic noise and make CTA color distinct from both gels.
schemes.attention_use: Colored edge separation creates immediate novelty and shape definition.
cautions: Cyberpunk palette can become cliché or conflict with brand colors.

schemes.light_logic: Hard directional light passes through blinds to cast striped bands across subject/surface.
schemes.copy_space: Do not place small text on striped zones; reserve a deliberately clear area.
schemes.attention_use: Bands create directional rhythm and can guide the eye when composition is controlled.
cautions: High-frequency stripes compete with typography.

schemes.light_logic: Even all-around light inside a light tent minimizes hard shadows and uncontrolled reflections.
schemes.copy_space: Clean field is easy for copy, but product still needs scale/contrast to dominate.
schemes.attention_use: Fine detail rather than dramatic light becomes the focal cue.
cautions: Can lack emotional character.

schemes.light_logic: Low warm back/side sunlight creates rim, long soft shadows, and atmospheric warmth.
schemes.copy_space: Use uncluttered sky/wall/surface regions; avoid text over flare/haze gradients.
schemes.attention_use: Warm rim and long shadows can create a natural directional flow.
cautions: Warm cast can distort product/brand colors.

schemes.light_logic: Soft cool ambient twilight with a subtle warm practical accent.
schemes.copy_space: Gradient blue fields can be excellent copy zones if contrast is measured.
schemes.attention_use: Warm/cool contrast can create a controlled focal accent.
cautions: Low contrast may hurt small-format legibility.

schemes.light_logic: Soft directional daylight from one side with subtle reflector fill.
schemes.copy_space: Choose uncluttered interior negative space and preserve tonal consistency behind text.
schemes.attention_use: Natural falloff feels credible and can softly lead from subject into copy.
cautions: Background lifestyle props can become competing AOIs.

schemes.light_logic: Direct overhead sunlight creates hard highlights and deep high-contrast shadows.
schemes.copy_space: Use intentionally flat background areas; avoid small type over shadow edges.
schemes.attention_use: Graphic highlights/shadows create a strong editorial stop.
cautions: Unforgiving for product detail and premium subtlety.

schemes.light_logic: Even diffused outdoor light with no harsh shadows and honest color.
schemes.copy_space: Easy to reserve quiet organic negative space.
schemes.attention_use: Low visual drama supports trust and material authenticity.
cautions: Needs layout/scale/color to create enough stopping power.

schemes.light_logic: Strong directional shaft passes through haze/dust and hits the subject in a dark scene.
schemes.copy_space: Never run essential text through rays/haze texture; reserve a quiet dark field.
schemes.attention_use: Beam can point directly to hero and create depth.
cautions: Extremely salient; easy to overpower the commercial message.

schemes.light_logic: Visible/practical magenta-cyan lights and wet reflective surfaces create colored reflections.
schemes.copy_space: Use dark quiet zones; avoid CTA colors that disappear into neon palette.
schemes.attention_use: Colored reflections and bokeh create strong novelty and nightlife cues.
cautions: Can become visually noisy or cliché.

schemes.light_logic: Low warm practical candlelight from one side creates soft falloff and amber highlights.
schemes.copy_space: Dark background may support copy; avoid very small warm-on-warm text.
schemes.attention_use: Localized warm glow creates intimacy and a small focal island.
cautions: Color cast and low light can reduce product color accuracy.

schemes.light_logic: Sunlight filtered through leaves casts organic moving-looking patterns with natural props/droplets.
schemes.copy_space: Reserve a clean area away from leaf-shadow patterns.
schemes.attention_use: Organic light patterns add category cues while hero remains central.
cautions: Leaf shadows can clutter type and create false focal patches.

schemes.light_logic: Top-down 90° view with soft side light/refill and balanced asymmetric props.
schemes.copy_space: Plan negative space explicitly in the prop arrangement.
schemes.attention_use: Props and diagonals can form leading lines toward the hero.
cautions: This is primarily a composition/angle pattern; too many props create clutter.

schemes.light_logic: Glossy black reflective base, soft key, and rear rim create a controlled mirror reflection.
schemes.copy_space: Keep text out of the reflection axis or use an adjacent dark field.
schemes.attention_use: Reflection reinforces the vertical hero axis and premium material presence.
cautions: Reflection can double visual weight and compete with copy in small formats.
